en: The image is a black-and-white vintage postcard showing a river with a paddle steamer, an iron bridge, and a grand historical castle on a hill in the background. Prominent text near the bottom says 'Meissen. Kgl. Albrechtsburg.' The cathedral tower on a hill and the construction scaffolding are notable. Period street lamps and a riverside walkway are visible in the foreground.
